tagline: Power cables and conductors, built to carry the load.

about.summary: JBPPL develops and markets a wide range of wires, cables and conductors for domestic markets. JBPPL manufactures Low Voltage (LV) power cables, aerial bunched cables and conductors, serving both retail and institutional segments under the brand name "POWERCON". To strengthen the supply chain, JBPPL believes in expanding to new verticals through backward integration for wires and cables; our clientele includes reputed Central & State Government power distribution houses.
about.mission: Power India's growth. Lead in renewable energy. Invest in people and technology for the future. Diversify and expand. Make social responsibility personal through impactful CSR initiatives.
about.vision: Empowering India: be the leading Power Infrastructure Company in India, driving national progress. Self-Reliant India: champion 'Make in India', fostering domestic manufacturing excellence. Global Footprint: expand our reach, catering to domestic demand and exploring global opportunities. Tech-Enabled Manufacturing: embed technology in our DNA, striving for 100% automation under human supervision.
about.history: Built on decades of trading and manufacturing experience brought in by its Directors, JB Powercon has grown into an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified manufacturer of power cables and conductors, serving India's infrastructure and energy sectors.

certificationScope: Manufacture and supply of bare & insulated, covered conductors (i.e. ACSR, AAC, AAAC, stranded aluminium wire) for power transmission & distribution lines and AB cables XLPE (aluminium), UG cable, PVC & XLPE insulated sheathed, unsheathed armoured and unarmoured single, multicore cables, power cables.
